385: static inline int wget_parsestatus(struct webclient_context *ctx,
386:                                    struct wget_s *ws)
387: {
388:   int offset;
389:   int ndx;
390:   char *dest;
391: 
392:   offset = ws->offset;
393:   ndx    = ws->ndx;
394: 
395:   while (offset < ws->datend)
396:     {
397:       bool got_nl;
398: 
399:       ws->line[ndx] = ws->buffer[offset++];
400:       got_nl = ws->line[ndx] == ISO_NL;
401:       if (got_nl || ndx == CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE - 1)
402:         {
403:           if (!got_nl)
404:             {
405:               nerr("ERROR: HTTP status line didn't fit "
406:                    "CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE: %.*s\n",
407:                    ndx, ws->line);
408:               return -E2BIG;
409:             }
410: 
411:           /* HTTP status line is something like:
412:            *
413:            * HTTP/1.1 200 OK
414:            *
415:            * https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7230#section-3.1.2
416:            *
417:            * > status-line = HTTP-version SP status-code \
418:            * >               SP reason-phrase CRLF
419:            */
420: 
421:           ws->line[ndx] = '\0';
422:           if ((strncmp(ws->line, g_http10, strlen(g_http10)) == 0) ||
423:               (strncmp(ws->line, g_http11, strlen(g_http11)) == 0))
424:             {
425:               unsigned long http_status;
426:               char *ep;
427: 
428:               DEBUGASSERT(strlen(g_http10) == 8);
429:               DEBUGASSERT(strlen(g_http11) == 8);
430: 
431:               /* SP before the status-code */
432: 
433:               if (ws->line[8] != ' ')
434:                 {
435:                   return -EINVAL;
436:                 }
437: 
438:               dest = &(ws->line[9]);  /* the status-code */
439:               ws->httpstatus = HTTPSTATUS_NONE;
440: 
441:               errno = 0;
442:               http_status = strtoul(dest, &ep, 10);
443:               if (ep == dest)
444:                 {
445:                   return -EINVAL;
446:                 }
447: 
448:               /* SP before reason-phrase */
449: 
450:               if (*ep != ' ')
451:                 {
452:                   return -EINVAL;
453:                 }
454: 
455:               if (errno != 0)
456:                 {
457:                   return -errno;
458:                 }
459: 
460:               ctx->http_status = http_status;
461:               ninfo("Got HTTP status %lu\n", http_status);
462:               if (ctx->http_reason != NULL)
463:                 {
464:                   strlcpy(ctx->http_reason,
465:                           ep + 1,
466:                           ctx->http_reason_len);
467:                 }
468: 
469:               /* Check for 2xx (Successful) */
470: 
471:               if ((http_status / 100) == 2)
472:                 {
473:                   ws->httpstatus = HTTPSTATUS_OK;
474:                 }
475: 
476:               /* Check for 3xx (Redirection)
477:                * Location: header line will contain the new location.
478:                *
479:                * Note: the following 3xx are not redirects.
480:                *   304 not modified
481:                *   305 use proxy
482:                */
483: 
484:               else if ((http_status / 100) == 3 &&
485:                        (http_status != 304) &&
486:                        (http_status != 305))
487:                 {
488:                   ws->httpstatus = HTTPSTATUS_MOVED;
489:                 }
490:             }
491:           else
492:             {
493:               return -ECONNABORTED;
494:             }
495: 
496:           /* We're done parsing the status line, so start parsing
497:            * the HTTP headers.
498:            */
499: 
500:           ws->state = WEBCLIENT_STATE_HEADERS;
501:           ws->internal_flags &= ~(WGET_FLAG_GOT_CONTENT_LENGTH |
502:                                   WGET_FLAG_CHUNKED |
503:                                   WGET_FLAG_GOT_LOCATION);
504:           ndx = 0;
505:           break;
506:         }
507:       else
508:         {
509:           ndx++;
510:         }
511:     }
512: 
513:   ws->offset = offset;
514:   ws->ndx    = ndx;
515:   return OK;
516: }

570:                                     struct wget_s *ws)
571: {
572:   int offset;
573:   int ndx;
574:   int ret = OK;
575: 
576:   offset = ws->offset;
577:   ndx    = ws->ndx;
578: 
579:   while (offset < ws->datend)
580:     {
581:       bool got_nl;
582: 
583:       ws->line[ndx] = ws->buffer[offset++];
584:       got_nl = ws->line[ndx] == ISO_NL;
585:       if (got_nl || ndx == CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE - 1)
586:         {
587:           bool found;
588: 
589:           if (ws->skip_to_next_line)
590:             {
591:               if (got_nl)
592:                 {
593:                   ws->skip_to_next_line = false;
594:                 }
595: 
596:               ndx = 0;
597:               continue;
598:             }
599: 
600:           /* We have an entire HTTP header line in ws->line, or
601:            * our buffer is already full, so we start parsing it.
602:            */
603: 
604:           found = false;
605: 
606:           /* Should always be true */
607: 
608:           if (ndx > 0)
609:             {
610:               ninfo("Got HTTP header line%s: %.*s\n",
611:                     got_nl ? "" : " (truncated)",
612:                     ndx - 1, &ws->line[0]);
613: 
614:               if (ws->line[0] == ISO_CR)
615:                 {
616:                   /* This was the last header line (i.e., and empty "\r\n"),
617:                    * so we are done with the headers and proceed with the
618:                    * actual data.
619:                    */
620: 
621:                   if ((ws->internal_flags & WGET_FLAG_CHUNKED) != 0)
622:                     {
623:                       ws->state = WEBCLIENT_STATE_CHUNKED_HEADER;
624:                       ndx = 0;
625:                     }
626:                   else
627:                     {
628:                       if ((ctx->flags & WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL) != 0)
629:                         {
630:                           if (ctx->http_status / 100 == 2)
631:                             {
632:                               ninfo("Tunnel established\n");
633:                               ws->state = WEBCLIENT_STATE_TUNNEL_ESTABLISHED;
634:                             }
635:                           else
636:                             {
637:                               ninfo("HTTP error from tunnelling proxy: %u\n",
638:                                     ctx->http_status);
639:                               ws->state = WEBCLIENT_STATE_DATA;
640:                             }
641:                         }
642:                       else
643:                         {
644:                           ws->state = WEBCLIENT_STATE_DATA;
645:                         }
646:                     }
647: 
648:                   goto exit;
649:                 }
650: 
651:               /* Truncate the trailing \r\n */
652: 
653:               if (got_nl)
654:                 {
655:                   ndx--;
656:                   if (ws->line[ndx] != ISO_CR)
657:                     {
658:                       nerr("ERROR: unexpected EOL from the server\n");
659:                       return -EPROTO;
660:                     }
661:                 }
662: 
663:               ws->line[ndx] = '\0';
664: 
665:               if (!strchr(ws->line, ':'))
666:                 {
667:                   if (got_nl)
668:                     {
669:                       nerr("ERROR: invalid header possibly due to "
670:                            "small CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE\n");
671:                       return -E2BIG;
672:                     }
673: 
674:                   nerr("ERROR: invalid header\n");
675:                   return -EPROTO;
676:                 }
677: 
678:               if (ctx->header_callback)
679:                 {
680:                   ret = ctx->header_callback(&ws->line[0], !got_nl,
681:                                              ctx->header_callback_arg);
682:                   if (ret != 0)
683:                     {
684:                       goto exit;
685:                     }
686:                 }
687: 
688:               /* Check for specific HTTP header fields. */
689: 
690: #ifdef CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_GETMIMETYPE
691:               if (strncasecmp(ws->line, g_httpcontenttype,
692:                               strlen(g_httpcontenttype)) == 0)
693:                 {
694:                   /* Found Content-type field. */
695: 
696:                   char *dest = strchr(ws->line, ';');
697:                   if (dest != NULL)
698:                     {
699:                       *dest = 0;
700:                     }
701: 
702:                   strlcpy(ws->mimetype, ws->line + strlen(g_httpcontenttype),
703:                           sizeof(ws->mimetype));
704:                   found = true;
705:                 }
706:               else
707: #endif
708:               if (strncasecmp(ws->line, g_httplocation,
709:                               strlen(g_httplocation)) == 0)
710:                 {
711:                   /* Parse the new host and filename from the URL.
712:                    */
713: 
714:                   ninfo("Redirect to location: '%s'\n",
715:                         ws->line + strlen(g_httplocation));
716:                   ret = parseurl(ws->line + strlen(g_httplocation),
717:                                  &ws->target, false);
718:                   if (ret != 0)
719:                     {
720:                       goto exit;
721:                     }
722: 
723:                   ninfo("New hostname='%s' filename='%s'\n",
724:                         ws->target.hostname, ws->target.filename);
725:                   ws->internal_flags |= WGET_FLAG_GOT_LOCATION;
726:                   found = true;
727:                 }
728:               else if (strncasecmp(ws->line, g_httpcontsize,
729:                                    strlen(g_httpcontsize)) == 0)
730:                 {
731:                   found = true;
732:                   if (got_nl)
733:                     {
734:                       ret = wget_parseint(ws->line + strlen(g_httpcontsize),
735:                                           &ws->expected_resp_body_len, 10);
736:                       if (ret != 0)
737:                         {
738:                           goto exit;
739:                         }
740: 
741:                       ws->internal_flags |=
742:                           WGET_FLAG_GOT_CONTENT_LENGTH;
743:                       ninfo("Content-Length %ju\n",
744:                             ws->expected_resp_body_len);
745:                     }
746:                 }
747:               else if (strncasecmp(ws->line, g_httptransferencoding,
748:                                    strlen(g_httptransferencoding)) == 0)
749:                 {
750:                   FAR const char *encodings =
751:                       ws->line + strlen(g_httptransferencoding);
752: 
753:                   if (strcasecmp(encodings, "chunked"))
754:                     {
755:                       nerr("unknown encodings: '%s'\n", encodings);
756:                       return -EPROTO;
757:                     }
758: 
759:                   ninfo("transfer encodings: '%s'\n", encodings);
760:                   ws->internal_flags |= WGET_FLAG_CHUNKED;
761:                 }
762:             }
763: 
764:           if (found && !got_nl)
765:             {
766:               /* We found something we might care.
767:                * but we couldn't process it correctly.
768:                */
769: 
770:               nerr("ERROR: truncated a header due to "
771:                    "small CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE\n");
772:               return -E2BIG;
773:             }
774: 
775:           /* We're done parsing ws->line, so we reset the index.
776:            *
777:            * If we haven't seen the entire line yet (!got_nl),
778:            * skip the rest of the line.
779:            * Otherwise, start processing the next line.
780:            */
781: 
782:           ndx = 0;
783:           ws->skip_to_next_line = !got_nl;
784:         }
785:       else
786:         {
787:           ndx++;
788:         }
789:     }
790: 
791: exit:
792:   ws->offset = offset;
793:   ws->ndx    = ndx;
794:   return ret;
795: }

797: /****************************************************************************
798:  * Name: wget_parsechunkheader
799:  ****************************************************************************/
800: 
801: static inline int wget_parsechunkheader(struct webclient_context *ctx,
802:                                         struct wget_s *ws)
803: {
804:   int offset;
805:   int ndx;
806:   int ret = OK;
807: 
808:   UNUSED(ctx);
809: 
810:   offset = ws->offset;
811:   ndx    = ws->ndx;
812: 
813:   while (offset < ws->datend)
814:     {
815:       bool got_nl;
816: 
817:       ws->line[ndx] = ws->buffer[offset++];
818:       got_nl = ws->line[ndx] == ISO_NL;
819:       if (got_nl || ndx == CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE - 1)
820:         {
821:           bool found_extension = false;
822: 
823:           /* We have an entire header line in ws->line, or
824:            * our buffer is already full, so we start parsing it.
825:            */
826: 
827:           /* Should always be true */
828: 
829:           if (ndx > 0)
830:             {
831:               FAR char *semicolon;
832: 
833:               ninfo("Got chunk header line%s: %.*s\n",
834:                     got_nl ? "" : " (truncated)",
835:                     ndx - 1, &ws->line[0]);
836: 
837:               if (ws->line[0] == ISO_CR)
838:                 {
839:                   nerr("ERROR: empty chunk header\n");
840:                   ret = -EPROTO;
841:                   break;
842:                 }
843: 
844:               /* Truncate the trailing \r\n */
845: 
846:               if (got_nl)
847:                 {
848:                   ndx--;
849:                   if (ws->line[ndx] != ISO_CR)
850:                     {
851:                       nerr("ERROR: unexpected EOL from the server\n");
852:                       ret = -EPROTO;
853:                       break;
854:                     }
855:                 }
856: 
857:               ws->line[ndx] = '\0';
858: 
859:               semicolon = strchr(ws->line, ';');
860:               if (semicolon != NULL)
861:                 {
862:                   found_extension = true;
863:                   ninfo("Ignoring extentions in chunk header\n");
864:                   *semicolon = 0;
865:                 }
866:             }
867: 
868:           if (!got_nl && !found_extension)
869:             {
870:               /* We found something we might care.
871:                * but we couldn't process it correctly.
872:                */
873: 
874:               nerr("ERROR: truncated a header due to "
875:                    "small CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE\n");
876:               ret = -E2BIG;
877:               break;
878:             }
879: 
880:           ret = wget_parseint(ws->line, &ws->chunk_len, 16);
881:           if (ret != 0)
882:             {
883:               break;
884:             }
885: 
886:           if (ws->chunk_len != 0)
887:             {
888:               ninfo("Receiving a chunk with %ju bytes\n", ws->chunk_len);
889:               ws->state = WEBCLIENT_STATE_CHUNKED_DATA;
890:               ws->chunk_received = 0;
891:             }
892:           else
893:             {
894:               ws->state = WEBCLIENT_STATE_CHUNKED_TRAILER;
895:             }
896: 
897:           ndx = 0;
898:           break;
899:         }
900:       else
901:         {
902:           ndx++;
903:         }
904:     }
905: 
906:   ws->offset = offset;
907:   ws->ndx    = ndx;
908:   return ret;
909: }

1024: /****************************************************************************
1025:  * Name: wget_gethostip
1026:  *
1027:  * Description:
1028:  *   Call getaddrinfo() to get the IPv4 address associated with a hostname.
1029:  *
1030:  * Input Parameters
1031:  *   hostname - The host name to use in the nslookup.
1032:  *
1033:  * Output Parameters
1034:  *   dest     - The location to return the IPv4 address.
1035:  *
1036:  * Returned Value:
1037:  *   Zero (OK) on success; ERROR on failure.
1038:  *
1039:  ****************************************************************************/
1040: 
1041: static int wget_gethostip(FAR char *hostname, FAR struct in_addr *dest)
1042: {
1043: #ifdef CONFIG_LIBC_NETDB
1044:   FAR struct addrinfo hint;
1045:   FAR struct addrinfo *info;
1046:   FAR struct sockaddr_in *addr;
1047: 
1048:   memset(&hint, 0, sizeof(hint));
1049:   hint.ai_family = AF_INET;
1050: 
1051:   if (getaddrinfo(hostname, NULL, &hint, &info) != OK)
1052:     {
1053:       return ERROR;
1054:     }
1055: 
1056:   addr = (FAR struct sockaddr_in *)info->ai_addr;
1057:   memcpy(dest, &addr->sin_addr, sizeof(struct in_addr));
1058: 
1059:   freeaddrinfo(info);
1060:   return OK;
1061: #else
1062:   /* No host name support */
1063: 
1064:   /* Convert strings to numeric IPv4 address */
1065: 
1066:   int ret = inet_pton(AF_INET, hostname, dest);
1067: 
1068:   /* The inet_pton() function returns 1 if the conversion succeeds. It will
1069:    * return 0 if the input is not a valid IPv4 dotted-decimal string or -1
1070:    * with errno set to EAFNOSUPPORT if the address family argument is
1071:    * unsupported.
1072:    */
1073: 
1074:   return (ret > 0) ? OK : ERROR;
1075: #endif
1076: }

1107:             }
1108: 
1109:           return -errno;
1110:         }
1111: 
1112:       return ret;
1113:     }

1176: /****************************************************************************
1177:  * Name: webclient_perform
1178:  *
1179:  * Returned Value:
1180:  *               0: if the operation completed successfully;
1181:  *  Negative errno: On a failure
1182:  *
1183:  ****************************************************************************/
1184: 
1185: int webclient_perform(FAR struct webclient_context *ctx)
1186: {
1187:   struct wget_s *ws;
1188:   struct timeval tv;
1189:   char *dest;
1190:   char *ep;
1191:   struct webclient_conn_s *conn;
1192:   FAR const struct webclient_tls_ops *tls_ops = ctx->tls_ops;
1193:   FAR const char *method = ctx->method;
1194:   FAR void *tls_ctx = ctx->tls_ctx;
1195:   unsigned int i;
1196:   int len;
1197:   int ret;
1198: 
1199: #ifdef CONFIG_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS
1200:   DEBUGASSERT(ctx->state == WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_INITIALIZED ||
1201:               (ctx->state == WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_IN_PROGRESS &&
1202:                (ctx->flags & WEBCLIENT_FLAG_NON_BLOCKING) != 0));
1203: #endif
1204: 
1205: #if defined(CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_NET_LOCAL)
1206:   if (ctx->unix_socket_path != NULL && ctx->proxy != NULL)
1207:     {
1208:       nerr("ERROR: proxy with AF_LOCAL is not implemented");
1209:       _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_DONE);
1210:       return -ENOTSUP;
1211:     }
1212: #endif
1213: 
1214:   /* Initialize the state structure */
1215: 
1216:   if (ctx->ws == NULL)
1217:     {
1218:       ws = calloc(1, sizeof(struct wget_s));
1219:       if (!ws)
1220:         {
1221:           _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_DONE);
1222:           return -errno;
1223:         }
1224: 
1225:       ws->conn = calloc(1, sizeof(struct webclient_conn_s));
1226:       if (!ws->conn)
1227:         {
1228:           free_ws(ws);
1229:           _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_DONE);
1230:           return -errno;
1231:         }
1232: 
1233:       ws->buffer = ctx->buffer;
1234:       ws->buflen = ctx->buflen;
1235: 
1236:       /* Parse the hostname (with optional port number) and filename
1237:        * from the URL.
1238:        */
1239: 
1240:       if ((ctx->flags & WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL) == 0)
1241:         {
1242:           ret = parseurl(ctx->url, &ws->target, false);
1243:           if (ret != 0)
1244:             {
1245:               nwarn("WARNING: Malformed URL: %s\n", ctx->url);
1246:               free_ws(ws);
1247:               _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_DONE);
1248:               return ret;
1249:             }
1250:         }
1251: 
1252:       if (ctx->proxy != NULL)
1253:         {
1254:           /* Note: reject a proxy string w/o port number specified.
1255:            * It's better to be explicit because the default number varies
1256:            * among HTTP client implementations.
1257:            * (80, 1080, 3128, 8080, ...)
1258:            */
1259: 
1260:           ret = parseurl(ctx->proxy, &ws->proxy, true);
1261:           if (ret != 0)
1262:             {
1263:               nerr("ERROR: Malformed proxy setting: %s\n", ctx->proxy);
1264:               free_ws(ws);
1265:               _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_DONE);
1266:               return ret;
1267:             }
1268: 
1269:           if (strcmp(ws->proxy.scheme, "http") ||
1270:               strcmp(ws->proxy.filename, "/"))
1271:             {
1272:               nerr("ERROR: Unsupported proxy setting: %s\n", ctx->proxy);
1273:               free_ws(ws);
1274:               _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_DONE);
1275:               return -ENOTSUP;
1276:             }
1277:         }
1278: 
1279:       ws->state = WEBCLIENT_STATE_SOCKET;
1280:       ctx->ws = ws;
1281:     }
1282: 
1283:   ws = ctx->ws;
1284: 
1285:   ninfo("hostname='%s' filename='%s'\n", ws->target.hostname,
1286:         ws->target.filename);
1287: 
1288:   /* The following sequence may repeat indefinitely if we are redirected */
1289: 
1290:   conn = ws->conn;
1291:   do
1292:     {
1293:       if (ws->state == WEBCLIENT_STATE_SOCKET)
1294:         {
1295:           if ((ctx->flags & WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL) != 0)
1296:             {
1297:               conn->tls = false;
1298:             }
1299:           else if (!strcmp(ws->target.scheme, "https") && tls_ops != NULL)
1300:             {
1301:               conn->tls = true;
1302:               conn->tls_ops = tls_ops;
1303:               conn->tls_ctx = ctx->tls_ctx;
1304:             }
1305:           else if (!strcmp(ws->target.scheme, "http"))
1306:             {
1307:               conn->tls = false;
1308:             }
1309:           else
1310:             {
1311:               nerr("ERROR: unsupported scheme: %s\n", ws->target.scheme);
1312:               free_ws(ws);
1313:               _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_DONE);
1314:               return -ENOTSUP;
1315:             }
1316: 
1317:           /* Re-initialize portions of the state structure that could have
1318:            * been left from the previous time through the loop and should not
1319:            * persist with the new connection.
1320:            */
1321: 
1322:           ws->httpstatus = HTTPSTATUS_NONE;
1323:           ws->offset     = 0;
1324:           ws->datend     = 0;
1325:           ws->ndx        = 0;
1326:           ws->redirected = 0;
1327: 
1328:           if (conn->tls)
1329:             {
1330: #if defined(CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_NET_LOCAL)
1331:               if (ctx->unix_socket_path != NULL)
1332:                 {
1333:                   nerr("ERROR: TLS on AF_LOCAL socket is not implemented\n");
1334:                   free_ws(ws);
1335:                   _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_DONE);
1336:                   return -ENOTSUP;
1337:                 }
1338: #endif
1339: 
1340:               if (ctx->proxy != NULL)
1341:                 {
1342:                   FAR struct webclient_context *tunnel;
1343: 
1344:                   DEBUGASSERT(ws->tunnel == NULL);
1345: 
1346:                   if (tls_ops->init_connection == NULL)
1347:                     {
1348:                       nerr("ERROR: TLS over proxy is not implemented\n");
1349:                       ret = -ENOTSUP;
1350:                       goto errout_with_errno;
1351:                     }
1352: 
1353:                   /* Create a temporary context to establish a tunnel. */
1354: 
1355:                   ws->tunnel = tunnel = calloc(1, sizeof(*ws->tunnel));
1356:                   if (tunnel == NULL)
1357:                     {
1358:                       ret = -ENOMEM;
1359:                       goto errout_with_errno;
1360:                     }
1361: 
1362:                   webclient_set_defaults(tunnel);
1363:                   tunnel->method = "CONNECT";
1364:                   tunnel->flags |= WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL;
1365:                   tunnel->tunnel_target_host = ws->target.hostname;
1366:                   tunnel->tunnel_target_port = ws->target.port;
1367:                   tunnel->proxy = ctx->proxy;
1368:                   tunnel->proxy_headers = ctx->proxy_headers;
1369:                   tunnel->proxy_nheaders = ctx->proxy_nheaders;
1370: 
1371:                   /* Inherit some configurations.
1372:                    *
1373:                    * Revisit: should there be independent configurations?
1374:                    */
1375: 
1376:                   tunnel->protocol_version = ctx->protocol_version;
1377:                   if ((ctx->flags & WEBCLIENT_FLAG_NON_BLOCKING) != 0)
1378:                     {
1379:                       tunnel->flags |= WEBCLIENT_FLAG_NON_BLOCKING;
1380:                     }
1381: 
1382:                   /* Abuse the buffer of the original request.
1383:                    * It's safe with the current usage.
1384:                    */
1385: 
1386:                   tunnel->buffer = ctx->buffer;
1387:                   tunnel->buflen = ctx->buflen;
1388:                 }
1389:             }
1390:           else
1391:             {
1392:               int domain;
1393: 
1394: #if defined(CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_NET_LOCAL)
1395:               if (ctx->unix_socket_path != NULL)
1396:                 {
1397:                   domain = PF_LOCAL;
1398:                 }
1399:               else
1400: #endif
1401:                 {
1402:                   domain = PF_INET;
1403:                 }
1404: 
1405:               /* Create a socket */
1406: 
1407:               conn->sockfd = socket(domain, SOCK_STREAM, 0);

113:  * keeping the tunneled connection open.

116:  * the user can use webclient_get_tunnel only once.
117:  * webclient_get_tunnel effectively detaches the returned

134: /* wget calls a user provided function of the following type to process
135:  * each received chuck of the incoming file data.  If the system has a file
136:  * system, then it may just write the data to a file.  Or it may buffer the
137:  * file in memory.  To facilitate this latter case, the caller may modify
138:  * the buffer address in this callback by writing to buffer and buflen. This
139:  * may be used, for example, to implement double buffering.
140:  *

142:  *   buffer - A pointer to a pointer to a buffer.  If the callee wishes to
143:  *       change the buffer address, it may do so in the callback by writing
144:  *       to buffer.
145:  *   offset - Offset to the beginning of valid data in the buffer.  Offset
146:  *       is used to skip over any HTTP header info that may be at the

171:  */

189:                                                 FAR void *arg);

194:  * webclient_context::bodylen bytes of the data.
195:  * It's the responsibility of this callback to maintain the current
196:  * "offset" of the data. (similarly to fread(3))

198:  * An implementation of this callback should perform either of
199:  * the followings:
200:  *
201:  * - Fill the buffer (specified by buffer and *sizep) with the data
202:  *
203:  * - Update *datap with a buffer filled with the data. In this case,
204:  *   it can return more than the amount specified *sizep.
205:  *
206:  * Either ways, it should update *sizep to the size of the data.

208:  * A short result is allowed. In that case, this callback will be called
209:  * again to provide the remaining data.
210:  *
211:  * Input Parameters:
212:  *   buffer  - The buffer to fill.
213:  *   sizep   - The size of buffer/data in bytes.
214:  *   datap   - The data to return.
215:  *   reqsize - The requested size.
216:  *             Note: This can be larger than *sizep.
217:  *             The callback can choose either of:
218:  *               * return more than *sizep data by updating *datap
219:  *                 with a large enough buffer

223:  *
224:  * Return value:
225:  *   0 on success.
226:  *   A negative errno on error.

232:     FAR const void * FAR *datap,

234:     FAR void *ctx);

278: /* Note on webclient_client lifetime
279:  *
280:  * (uninitialized)
281:  *      |
282:  * webclient_set_defaults
283:  *      |
284:  *      v
285:  *  INITIALIZED
286:  *      |
287:  *      |      IN-PROGRESS
288:  *      |        |
289:  *      |        +-------------+
290:  *      |        |             |
291:  *      |        |         webclient_abort
292:  *      |        |             |
293:  *      |        |             v
294:  *      |        |         ABORTED
295:  *      |        |
296:  * webclient_perform
297:  *      |
298:  *      |
299:  *      +-- non-blocking mode, returns -EAGAIN ---> IN-PROGRESS
300:  *      |
301:  *      +-- returns -errno ---> DONE
302:  *      |
303:  *     returns 0
304:  *      |
305:  *      +-- !WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL --> DONE
306:  *      |
307:  *      +-- WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL, http_status 2xx -----> TUNNEL_ESTABLISHED
308:  *      |
309:  *      +-- WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL, http_status others --> DONE
310:  *
311:  *
312:  *  TUNNEL_ESTABLISHED
313:  *      |
314:  * webclient_get_tunnel
315:  *      |
316:  *      v
317:  *     DONE
318:  *
319:  *
320:  * (uninitialized):
321:  *   After the memory for webclient_context is allocated,
322:  *   it should be initialized with webclient_set_defaults() before
323:  *   feeding it to other functions taking a webclient_context.
324:  *
325:  *   webclient_abort() makes the state back to this state.
326:  *   If the application wants to reuse the context for another request,
327:  *   it should initialize it with webclient_set_defaults() again.
328:  *
329:  * INITIALIZED:
330:  *   After calling webclient_set_defaults(), the application can set up
331:  *   the request parameters by setting the struct fields before the first
332:  *   call of webclient_perform().
333:  *   E.g. url, method, buffers, and callbacks.
334:  *
335:  *   webclient_set_static_body() can only be used in this state.
336:  *
337:  * IN-PROGRESS:
338:  *   This state only exists for the non-blocking mode.
339:  *
340:  *   webclient_get_poll_info() can only be used in this state.
341:  *
342:  * ABORTED:
343:  *   The HTTP operation has been aborted by webclient_abort().
344:  *
345:  * DONE:
346:  *   The HTTP operation has been completed. (Either successfully or not.)
347:  *
348:  *   The application can examine the struct fields to see the result.
349:  *   E.g. http_status and http_reason.
350:  *
351:  * ABORTED, DONE:
352:  *   The application can now dispose the resources associated to the
353:  *   context.
354:  *   E.g. buffers
355:  *
356:  *   If the application wants to reuse the context for another request,
357:  *   it should initialize it with webclient_set_defaults() again.
358:  *
359:  * TUNNEL_ESTABLISHED
360:  *   webclient_get_tunnel() should be called exactly once to return
361:  *   the established tunnel.
362:  */

364: struct webclient_context
365: {
366:   /* request parameters

/****************************************************************************

#include <nuttx/config.h>

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <sys/types.h>

/****************************************************************************
 * Pre-processor Definitions
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE
#  define CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHTTPLINE 200
#endif

#ifndef CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXMIMESIZE

#endif

#ifndef CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHOSTNAME
#  define CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXHOSTNAME 40
#endif

#ifndef CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXFILENAME
#  define CONFIG_WEBCLIENT_MAXFILENAME 100
#endif

#if defined(CONFIG_NETUTILS_CODECS)
#  if defined(CONFIG_CODECS_URLCODE)
#    define WGET_USE_URLENCODE 1
#  endif
#endif

/* The following WEBCLIENT_FLAG_xxx constants are for
 * webclient_context::flags.
 */

/* WEBCLIENT_FLAG_NON_BLOCKING tells webclient_perform() to
 * use non-blocking I/O.
 *
 * If this flag is set, webclient_perform() returns -EAGAIN
 * when it would otherwise block for network I/O. In that case,
 * the application should either retry the operation later by calling
 * webclient_perform() again, or abort it by calling webclient_abort().
 * It can also use webclient_get_poll_info() to avoid busy-retrying.
 *
 * If this flag is set, it's the application's responsibility to
 * implement a timeout.
 *
 * If the application specifies tls_ops, it's the application's
 * responsibility to make the TLS implementation to use non-blocking I/O
 * in addition to specifying this flag.
 *
 * Caveat: Even when this flag is set, the current implementation performs
 * the name resolution in a blocking manner.
 */

#define WEBCLIENT_FLAG_NON_BLOCKING 1U

/* WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL: Establish a tunnel
 *
 * If WEBCLIENT_FLAG_TUNNEL is set, ctx->url is ignored and
 * tunnel_target_host and tunnel_target_port members are used instead.
 *
 * Once a tunnel is established, webclient_perform returns success,
 * keeping the tunneled connection open.

 *
 * (uninitialized)
 *      |
 * webclient_set_defaults
 *      |
 *      v
 *  INITIALIZED

 *      |        |             |

 *      |        |             |

  FAR const char *proxy;

995:   char authorization[192];

997:   struct webclient_context context;
998:   struct mijia_response_s sink;
999:   cJSON *devices;
1000:   cJSON *homes;

1002:   cJSON *summary;

1004:   char *response;

1006:   char buffer[MIJIA_HTTP_BUFFER_SIZE];
1007:   const char *primary_home;
1008:   unsigned int detail_error_count;
1009:   unsigned int generated_at;
1010:   unsigned int home_count;
1011:   unsigned int room_count;

1015:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
1016: 
1017:   /* The model is ~118 KiB.  Both full sync and delta merge run inside the
1018:    * single mijia_worker thread, so a reused scratch buffer avoids a repeated
1019:    * large malloc/free cycle on every long poll change and keeps the heap
1020:    * free of fragmentation.
1021:    */
1022: 
1023:   static struct home_panel_family_model_s g_sync_model;
1024: 
1025:   response = malloc(CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_MAX_RESPONSE);

1034:   snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s/api/sync",

1038:   headers[0] = authorization;

1040:   sink.data = response;
1041:   sink.capacity = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_MAX_RESPONSE;

1043: 
1044:   webclient_set_defaults(&context);
1045:   context.method = "GET";
1046:   context.url = url;
1047:   context.buffer = buffer;
1048:   context.buflen = sizeof(buffer);
1049:   context.headers = headers;
1050:   context.nheaders = 2;
1051:   context.sink_callback = mijia_response_sink;
1052:   context.sink_callback_arg = &sink;
1053:   context.timeout_sec = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_TIMEOUT;
1054:   ret = webclient_perform(&context);
1055:   if (ret < 0 || context.http_status < 200 || context.http_status >= 300)
1056:     {
1057:       ret = ret < 0 ? ret :
1058:             context.http_status == 423 ? -EACCES : -EPROTO;
1059:       goto out;
1060:     }
1061: 
1062:   root = cJSON_Parse(response);
1063:   summary = root == NULL ? NULL :
1064:             cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "summary");
1065:   homes = root == NULL ? NULL :
1066:           cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "homes");
1067:   devices = root == NULL ? NULL :
1068:             cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "devices");
1069:   scenes = root == NULL ? NULL :
1070:            cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "scenes");
1071:   if (!cJSON_IsObject(summary) || !cJSON_IsArray(homes) ||
1072:       !cJSON_IsArray(devices) || !cJSON_IsArray(scenes) ||
1073:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "home_count", &home_count) ||
1074:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "room_count", &room_count) ||
1075:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "device_count", device_count) ||
1076:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "online_count", online_count) ||
1077:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "scene_count", &scene_count) ||
1078:       !mijia_json_uint(summary, "detail_error_count",
1079:                        &detail_error_count) ||
1080:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "generated_at", &generated_at) ||
1081:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "sync_revision", &server_revision) ||
1082:       *device_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(devices) ||
1083:       home_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(homes) ||
1084:       scene_count != (unsigned int)cJSON_GetArraySize(scenes) ||
1085:       *online_count > *device_count)
1086:     {
1087:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1088:       goto out;
1089:     }
1090: 
1091:   primary_home = mijia_json_string(summary, "primary_home_name");
1092:   mijia_copy_string(home_name, home_capacity, primary_home);
1093: 
1094:   /* Parsing the full family response is intentionally done in this
1095:    * low-priority worker.  The LVGL thread only copies the compact model,
1096:    * so a cloud update cannot stall input while cJSON walks the payload.
1097:    */
1098: 
1099:   parsed_model = &g_sync_model;
1100:   memset(parsed_model, 0, sizeof(*parsed_model));
1101: 
1102:   ret = home_panel_mijia_model_parse(response, 0, parsed_model);
1103:   if (ret < 0)
1104:     {
1105:       goto out;
1106:     }
1107: 
1108:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
1109:   if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation)
1110:     {
1111:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1112:       ret = -ECANCELED;
1113:       goto out;
1114:     }
1115: 
1116:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision = ++g_mijia.next_family_revision;
1117:   parsed_model->revision = g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision;
1118:   memcpy(&g_mijia.family_model, parsed_model, sizeof(*parsed_model));
1119:   g_mijia.family_model_valid = true;
1120:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision = server_revision;
1121:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.generated_at = generated_at;
1122:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.json_size = sink.length;
1123:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.home_count = home_count;
1124:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.room_count = parsed_model->room_count;
1125:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.device_count = parsed_model->device_count;
1126:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.online_count = parsed_model->online_count;
1127:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.scene_count = parsed_model->scene_count;
1128:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.detail_error_count = detail_error_count;
1129:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.consecutive_failures = 0;
1130:   g_mijia.family_snapshot.stale = false;
1131:   syslog(LOG_INFO,
1132:          "[HOME][SYNC] revision=%u server=%u bytes=%u homes=%u rooms=%u "
1133:          "devices=%u online=%u scenes=%u detail_errors=%u\n",
1134:          (unsigned int)g_mijia.family_snapshot.revision,
1135:          server_revision, (unsigned int)sink.length, home_count, room_count,
1136:          parsed_model->device_count, parsed_model->online_count,
1137:          parsed_model->scene_count, detail_error_count);
1138:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1139:   ret = 0;
1140: 
1141: out:
1142:   if (ret < 0)
1143:     {
1144:       syslog(LOG_WARNING,
1145:              "[HOME][SYNC] request failed ret=%d status=%u bytes=%u\n",
1146:              ret, context.http_status, (unsigned int)sink.length);
1147:     }
1148: 
1149:   cJSON_Delete(root);
1150:   free(response);
1151:   return ret;
1152: }

1154: static int mijia_wait_for_changes(const char *token, uint32_t generation,
1155:                                   uint32_t after, bool *changed,
1156:                                   bool *full_resync)
1157: {
1158:   char authorization[192];
1159:   const char *headers[2];
1160:   struct webclient_context context;
1161:   struct mijia_response_s sink;
1162:   cJSON *changes;
1163:   cJSON *item;
1164:   cJSON *params;
1165:   cJSON *root = NULL;
1166:   char *response;
1167:   char url[512];
1168:   char buffer[MIJIA_HTTP_BUFFER_SIZE];
1169:   const char *method;
1170:   const char *did;
1171:   unsigned int base_revision;
1172:   unsigned int generated_at;
1173:   unsigned int online_changes = 0;
1174:   unsigned int property_changes = 0;
1175:   unsigned int revision;
1176:   unsigned int working_device_count;
1177:   unsigned int working_online_count;
1178:   uint32_t working_model_revision;
1179:   int online_count_delta = 0;
1180:   bool model_changed = false;
1181:   bool resync_required;
1182:   bool server_stale;
1183:   struct home_panel_family_model_s *working_model = NULL;
1184:   int length;
1185:   int ret = -ENOMEM;
1186: 
1187:   /* Reused by the worker thread for the delta merge; the scratch model is
1188:    * 118 KiB and would otherwise be malloc'd and freed on every poll change.
1189:    */
1190: 
1191:   static struct home_panel_family_model_s g_sync_working_model;
1192: 
1193:   *changed = false;
1194:   *full_resync = false;
1195:   response = malloc(MIJIA_DELTA_RESPONSE_SIZE);
1196:   if (response == NULL)
1197:     {
1198:       return -ENOMEM;
1199:     }
1200: 
1201:   memset(&context, 0, sizeof(context));
1202:   memset(&sink, 0, sizeof(sink));
1203:   length = snprintf(url, sizeof(url),
1204:                     "%s/api/sync/changes?after=%u&timeout=8",
1205:                     CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_SERVER_URL,
1206:                     (unsigned int)after);
1207:   if (length < 0 || (size_t)length >= sizeof(url))
1208:     {
1209:       ret = -ENAMETOOLONG;
1210:       goto out;
1211:     }
1212: 
1213:   snprintf(authorization, sizeof(authorization),
1214:            "Authorization: Bearer %s", token);
1215:   headers[0] = authorization;
1216:   headers[1] = "Connection: close";
1217:   sink.data = response;
1218:   sink.capacity = MIJIA_DELTA_RESPONSE_SIZE;
1219:   response[0] = '\0';
1220: 
1221:   webclient_set_defaults(&context);
1222:   context.method = "GET";
1223:   context.url = url;
1224:   context.buffer = buffer;
1225:   context.buflen = sizeof(buffer);
1226:   context.headers = headers;
1227:   context.nheaders = 2;
1228:   context.sink_callback = mijia_response_sink;
1229:   context.sink_callback_arg = &sink;
1230:   context.timeout_sec = CONFIG_D13X_HOME_PANEL_MIJIA_TIMEOUT;
1231:   ret = webclient_perform(&context);
1232:   if (ret < 0 || context.http_status < 200 || context.http_status >= 300)
1233:     {
1234:       ret = ret < 0 ? ret :
1235:             context.http_status == 423 ? -EACCES : -EPROTO;
1236:       goto out;
1237:     }
1238: 
1239:   if (!mijia_generation_active(generation))
1240:     {
1241:       ret = -ECANCELED;
1242:       goto out;
1243:     }
1244: 
1245:   root = cJSON_Parse(response);
1246:   changes = root == NULL ? NULL :
1247:             cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "changes");
1248:   if (!cJSON_IsArray(changes) ||
1249:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "base_revision", &base_revision) ||
1250:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "revision", &revision) ||
1251:       !mijia_json_uint(root, "generated_at", &generated_at))
1252:     {
1253:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1254:       goto out;
1255:     }
1256: 
1257:   item = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "resync_required");
1258:   if (!cJSON_IsBool(item))
1259:     {
1260:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1261:       goto out;
1262:     }
1263:   resync_required = cJSON_IsTrue(item);
1264:   item = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(root, "stale");
1265:   if (!cJSON_IsBool(item))
1266:     {
1267:       ret = -EBADMSG;
1268:       goto out;
1269:     }
1270:   server_stale = cJSON_IsTrue(item);
1271: 
1272:   if (resync_required)
1273:     {
1274:       *changed = true;
1275:       *full_resync = true;
1276:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
1277:              "[HOME][SYNC] delta gap local=%u server=%u; full resync\n",
1278:              (unsigned int)after, revision);
1279:       ret = 0;
1280:       goto out;
1281:     }
1282: 
1283:   if (revision < after || base_revision != after)
1284:     {
1285:       /* The server reset its revision counter (service restart) or the local
1286:        * base no longer matches.  A permanent error would stall family
1287:        * synchronization forever because the worker retries with the same
1288:        * base.  Fall back to a full resync instead.
1289:        */
1290: 
1291:       *changed = true;
1292:       *full_resync = true;
1293:       syslog(LOG_INFO,
1294:              "[HOME][SYNC] delta base mismatch local=%u server=%u; "
1295:              "full resync\n",
1296:              (unsigned int)after, (unsigned int)revision);
1297:       ret = 0;
1298:       goto out;
1299:     }
1300: 
1301:   cJSON_ArrayForEach(item, changes)
1302:     {
1303:       method = mijia_json_string(item, "method");
1304:       params = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(item, "params");
1305:       if (method == NULL || !cJSON_IsArray(params))
1306:         {
1307:           ret = -EBADMSG;
1308:           goto out;
1309:         }
1310:       if (strcmp(method, "properties_changed") == 0)
1311:         {
1312:           property_changes += cJSON_GetArraySize(params);
1313:         }
1314:       else if (strcmp(method, "device_online_changed") == 0)
1315:         {
1316:           online_changes += cJSON_GetArraySize(params);
1317:         }
1318:       else
1319:         {
1320:           *changed = true;
1321:           *full_resync = true;
1322:           ret = 0;
1323:           goto out;
1324:         }
1325:     }
1326: 
1327:   if (server_stale && cJSON_GetArraySize(changes) == 0)
1328:     {
1329:       ret = -EAGAIN;
1330:       goto out;
1331:     }
1332: 
1333:   if (cJSON_GetArraySize(changes) == 0)
1334:     {
1335:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
1336:       if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation ||
1337:           g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision != after)
1338:         {
1339:           pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1340:           ret = -ECANCELED;
1341:           goto out;
1342:         }
1343: 
1344:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision = revision;
1345:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.generated_at = generated_at;
1346:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.json_size = sink.length;
1347:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.consecutive_failures = 0;
1348:       g_mijia.family_snapshot.stale = false;
1349:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1350:       ret = 0;
1351:       goto out;
1352:     }
1353: 
1354:   working_model = &g_sync_working_model;
1355:   memset(working_model, 0, sizeof(*working_model));
1356: 
1357:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mijia.lock);
1358:   if (generation != g_mijia.request_generation ||
1359:       !g_mijia.family_model_valid)
1360:     {
1361:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1362:       ret = -ECANCELED;
1363:       goto out;
1364:     }
1365: 
1366:   if (g_mijia.family_snapshot.server_revision != after)
1367:     {
1368:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1369:       *changed = true;
1370:       *full_resync = true;
1371:       ret = 0;
1372:       goto out;
1373:     }
1374: 
1375:   memcpy(working_model, &g_mijia.family_model, sizeof(*working_model));
1376:   working_model_revision = g_mijia.family_model.revision;
1377:   working_device_count = g_mijia.family_snapshot.device_count;
1378:   working_online_count = g_mijia.family_snapshot.online_count;
1379:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mijia.lock);
1380: 
1381:   cJSON_ArrayForEach(item, changes)
1382:     {
1383:       method = mijia_json_string(item, "method");
1384:       params = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(item, "params");
1385:       if (strcmp(method, "device_online_changed") == 0)
1386:         {
1387:           cJSON *param;
1388: 
1389:           cJSON_ArrayForEach(param, params)
1390:             {
1391:               cJSON *previous = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(
1392:                 param, "previous_value");
1393:               cJSON *value = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(param,
1394:                                                                "value");
1395:               int apply_ret;
1396: 
1397:               did = mijia_json_string(param, "did");
1398:               if (did == NULL || !cJSON_IsBool(previous) ||
1399:                   !cJSON_IsBool(value))
1400:                 {
1401:                   ret = -EBADMSG;
1402:                   goto out;
1403:                 }
1404: 
1405:               apply_ret = home_panel_mijia_model_apply_online(
1406:                 working_model, did, cJSON_IsTrue(value));
1407:               if (apply_ret == -ENOENT)
1408:                 {
1409:                   continue;
1410:                 }
1411:               if (apply_ret < 0)
1412:                 {
1413:                   ret = apply_ret;
1414:                   goto out;
1415:                 }
1416: 
1417:               if (apply_ret > 0)
1418:                 {
1419:                   if (cJSON_IsTrue(previous) != cJSON_IsTrue(value))
1420:                     {
1421:                       online_count_delta += cJSON_IsTrue(value) ? 1 : -1;
1422:                     }
1423:                   model_changed = true;
1424:                 }
1425:             }
1426:         }
1427:       else
1428:         {
1429:           cJSON *param;
1430: 
1431:           cJSON_ArrayForEach(param, params)
1432:             {
1433:               cJSON *code_item;
1434:               cJSON *value;
1435:               unsigned int siid;
1436:               unsigned int piid;
1437:               int apply_ret;
1438: 
1439:               did = mijia_json_string(param, "did");
1440:               code_item = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(param, "code");
1441:               value = cJSON_GetObjectItemCaseSensitive(param, "value");
1442:               if (did == NULL || !mijia_json_uint(param, "siid", &siid) ||
1443:                   !mijia_json_uint(param, "piid", &piid) ||
1444:                   siid == 0 || siid > UINT16_MAX ||
1445:                   piid == 0 || piid > UINT16_MAX ||
1446:                   !cJSON_IsNumber(code_item))
1447:                 {
1448:                   ret = -EBADMSG;
1449:                   goto out;
1450:                 }
1451: 
1452:               if (code_item->valueint != 0)
1453:                 {
1454:                   continue;
1455:                 }
1456: 
1457:               apply_ret = home_panel_mijia_model_apply_property(

There is exactly **one** location where `webclient_perform()` itself returns `-EAGAIN`:

```c
      _SET_STATE(ctx, WEBCLIENT_CONTEXT_STATE_IN_PROGRESS);

```

This is the `errout_with_errno` error-handling label at the bottom of the function. When `WEBCLIENT_FLAG_NON_BLOCKING` is set and the error is `-EAGAIN`, `-EINPROGRESS`, or `-EALREADY`, the function saves the state and returns `-EAGAIN` to the caller so it can poll/retry later.
